label: site
controller: Sony DualSense / DualSense Edge over HID (read_data.parse)
coordinates: target_* and cursor_* are sticks normalized to -1..1 around calibration.centers (positive side divided by 255-centre, negative side by centre), y grows downward. Right-stick targets are the left-stick targets mirrored (x flipped).

columns.t: active seconds since the level started (breaks are skipped)
columns.t_wall: wall-clock seconds since the level started (includes breaks)
columns.t_trial: active seconds since the apple pair appeared / the flight began; empty while waiting
columns.phase: wait = resting in the middle or moving to the start, cue = apples showing, return = both apples picked and coming back, track = following a moving target
columns.hand: left, right or both: which stick(s) the level uses
columns.reached_l / reached_r: 1 once that hand has picked its apple in this pair
columns.cursor_*: unsmoothed normalized stick positions (the drawn cursor is smoothed)

navigation: press X (or Space/Enter) to continue between screens; both sticks outward 1.4s to pause; hold either stick down 1.4s from pause to finish
